name: FlowHub POS Sync
description: FlowHub API credentials, optional outbound proxy, sync cadence and CCT storage. The connection checklist reads the Remote Sites store, the field mapping is a key/value table, and the location ID has no WordPress control, so all three are absent here.

settings.label: API base URL
settings.description: Override only when FlowHub changes or mirrors its endpoint.

settings.label: Enable proxy
settings.description: Routes FlowHub API requests through the proxy below, for regions FlowHub blocks.

settings.label: Sync direction
settings.description: Read-only caches the catalog without writing to WooCommerce.

settings.label: Low stock threshold
settings.description: Quantity below which an item is reported as low stock.

settings.label: CCT slug
settings.description: JetEngine CCT slug used for inventory storage, which must be unique. Leave blank to use the toolkit default.
